content.description: Cardano Ballot is a user-friendly, hybrid on- and off-chain voting system developed by the Cardano Foundation. Cardano Ballot leverages a set of backend services combined with frontend applications to facilitate voting within the Cardano Ecosystem. It supports an accurate, transparent, secure and verifiable ballot process. It has been used successfully for the Cardano Summit awards voting and you can read more about its launch from the Cardano Foundation Cardano Ballot is a user-friendly, hybrid on- and off-chain voting system developed by the Cardano.
